Specification: This module declares a fixed set of ten process identifiers and two state variables, one representing process clocks and one representing drift between pairs of clocks. It appears to be a small wrapper or model-checking module for another module named FoldExcept, but this file itself contains no behavior, initialization, next-state relation, temporal specification, or properties. The file mainly provides state-variable declarations, a concrete process set, and an INSTANCE declaration, with comments indicating intended types for the variables.
